items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: 'Shields, that's the only one I can think of.' ... 'But the Shields did live on 3rd street.'

ctx.x: Did you have a name in mind, Mr. Robinson? Huh? Did you have a name in mind, Dad?
That's just what I'm thinking now. Shields, that's the only one I can think of. No, but they got another one. They got another one there.
Did you say buddy or something like that? No.
